inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on documentation obtained and interviews completed, it was determined that caregivers failed to provide the level of supervision necessary. The child was able to leave the group without caregiver being aware that the child had wandered away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs: Infant was bottle fed once. Caregivers did not follow the feeding instructions given by parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §746.2401(4))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs: Instructions for infant to be fed based on feeding schedule were not followed, resulting in the infant not being fed an afternoon bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §746.2401(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: Older infant caregivers did not consistently provide parents with a daily report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: Caregiver and children were observed not washing their hands after diaper changing. Children were observed not washing their hands before snack.     Children and caregiver were observed washing hands after inspector approached them.
Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was observed sleeping on a bouncer.    Deficiency was corrected during inspection when I asked caregiver to place baby on a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During outdoor time, toddler children were observed playing closed to the playground back fence for around 19 minutes without been supervise by caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: A written incident report was not provided to parent whose child was injured falling off a play structure and needed medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Caregiver in charge of a toddler's class failed to supervise  a 20-month-old child who fell from a play structure. The toddler was observed on the ground for about 15 seconds before a caregiver noticed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: During walkthrough 12 infants ages 3-11 months were observed in room 8.    Corrected during inspection. Director was asked to use 3rd caregiver present to  move 2 infants out of room 8.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: During walkthrough 4 years old classroom was observed having screen time while eating lunch.     Deficiency was corrected during inspection. I explained caregiver standards about screen time. Caregiver was asked to turn Television off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Caregiver was observed inappropriately grabbing children by arm, leg and face. Caregiver was observed throwing a child?s lunch away before the child finished eating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Caregiver was observed inappropriately grabbing children by arm, leg and face. Caregiver was found to be abusive in that these actions placed the children at risk for injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A toddler was observed sleeping on a stack of 7 cots.      Deficiency was corrected during inspection when inspector asked caregivers to place toddler on one cot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: Caregiver was observed  not washing her hands after changing babies' diapers.     Caregiver was told that after each diaper change, she must wash her hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves (26 TAC §746.3505(c))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: Caregiver without First Aid Certification was left alone with children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: A child was not buckled while in a buggy and fell out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Caregiver in a 12-17 months infant room was out of ratio. Caregiver was alone with 8 infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: An infant was not properly supervised while seated in a buggy. Caregiver was involved in a conversation with another staff and was not able to intervene when the infant fell out of the buggy and was injured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))
